args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter summary — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest newsletter covers "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article and offering subscribers full charts via a companion link (unlocked with work email).
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
